items.author: kwame_ea
items.title: PSA: think twice about that "free" eviction clinic
items.body: Putting this out there because I'm angry. My neighbor went to the free tenant clinic the Cascade Legal Rights Project held last month at the library. Two weeks later she gets a letter from a landlord law firm with her name on it. Coincidence? They had everybody sign a sheet with name and address. I'm not saying they're selling names but somebody is getting that info. They're doing another one this Saturday. If you're behind on rent don't put your info on anybody's sheet.

items.author: GrantParkGail
items.body: Same thing happened to a guy in my building!! Got a mailer from some attorney about "your eviction case" and he never told anybody but the people at that clinic. Nonprofits get money from somewhere. Just saying.

items.author: MorelandMike
items.body: Not defending anybody but don't eviction filings show up at the courthouse? I thought lawyers pulled names from that. Would be good to hear from the org before we pile on.

items.author: denise.whitfield@cascaderights.example
items.title: East Atlanta board thread
items.body: Jasmine, the moderator emailed me about the thread. We need an official response up before Saturday. Please draft it from your board account and leave it as a draft, I want to read it tonight before anything goes up. Points: Policy — prohibited recipients: landlords and their attorneys; prohibited uses: sharing, sale or disclosure of attendee information. Sign-in records — retained internally, locked storage. Magistrate-court eviction filings — public records; used by some firms for tenant mailings. Likely explanation for the letters — public filings. Clinic is still on Saturday. Do not discuss any individual's situation, even to defend us. Keep it calm, no arguing with anyone by name. Denise
